owner_cards.heading: Card catalog
owner_cards.intro: Owner-only catalog management. Click a card to preview it. Filter by rarity or search at the top.
owner_cards.bulk_edit_sub: Only the filled fields are applied. Empty = unchanged.
owner_cards.bulk_rebake_sub: Applies this overlay to the whole selection. Original source required. Cards without an original source are skipped.
owner_cards.crop_hint: Fixed 2:3 ratio. Original source reloaded. Rarity overlay re-applied automatically.
owner_cards.edit_sub: Edit the card info then save.
owner_cards.f_event_hint: — card boosted on rolls during the event (always stays obtainable)
owner_cards.not_obtainable_hint: — hidden from the catalog + never rolled

owner_events.intro: Random card drops in a channel. The first reaction on the message wins the card. Configured per server (min-max interval + minimum rarity). Manual trigger to test.
owner_events.channels_hint: If the channels do not show up: click 🔄 next to the server in the configs below to refresh.
owner_events.element_circle_help: Each one is strong (×1.25) against the next one and weak (×0.8) against the previous one.
owner_events.sim_help: Posts a card in /roll format in a channel + pings the wishers. Gives the card to nobody (pure test of the wishlist notifications).
owner_events.fake_help: Classic drop (image + code to type) of the card of your choice. Once claimed, the bot reveals it was fake and mocks the claimer — no card is given.
owner_events.wheel_help: Reset = everyone can spin again immediately. Clear the list = only wipes the "live" feed (it does not allow spinning again).
owner_events.rolls_help: Reset = resets the roll cooldown for everyone (anyone can re-roll right away). Give = grants N bonus rolls to everyone (non-refillable, consumed before the normal rolls).
owner_events.bonus_rolls_all: Bonus rolls to give to everyone
owner_events.coupons_help: Gives Golden Roll (guaranteed legendary) or Epic Roll (guaranteed epic) coupons, to a specific user or to everyone (leave the ID empty).
owner_events.test_user_help: Target a Discord ID (e.g. your test account) to check reset/give before applying it to everyone.
owner_events.global_cfg_help: These settings apply to every server that enabled Cards Events. The bot drops a card every X minutes (random min-max interval), above the minimum rarity. The channel is picked automatically per server (system channel, or the first channel the bot can write in).

owner_suggestions.heading: Card suggestions
owner_suggestions.intro_1: Community suggestions via /cardsuggest on the support server.
owner_suggestions.intro_2: Approve = creates the card. Reject = rejects it with an optional reason.
owner_suggestions.crop_hint: Adjust the frame (fixed 2:3 portrait ratio). Output 450×675px.

owner_theme_event.global_sub: Enable a seasonal or one-off event for every server: the cards tagged to the event get a boosted drop during the event. They always stay obtainable (no exclusivity, so newcomers are never penalised).
owner_theme_event.ev_active_hint: "None" disables the boost. Event cards stay rollable normally outside the event.
owner_theme_event.drop_boost_hint: — chance multiplier for the cards tagged to the event. 1 = no boost.
owner_theme_event.drop_boost_help: E.g. 2 = the event cards drop 2× more often. Exception: for a player who already owns the card at 5⭐, their rate goes back to normal (no more boost on that card for them).
owner_theme_event.rare_boost_hint: — boosts the WHOLE rare pool during the event. 1 = none.
owner_theme_event.rare_boost_help: E.g. 1.5 = +50% chance to pull epic/legendary/mythic (on top of the event card boost). 1 = disabled.
owner_theme_event.test_guilds_hint: — IDs separated by commas. Empty = everyone.
owner_theme_event.test_guilds_help: If filled: the event (boost, /eventfight, /eventshop, /daily tokens) is only active on those servers. Ideal to test before a global launch.
owner_theme_event.rates_hint: — recomputed from the rare boost above
owner_theme_event.cards_sub: Pick the cards affected by the drop boost for a given event.
owner_theme_event.card_rates: 📈 Drop rate per event card (with boosts)
